findings.reason: the plan must state that a raise from `discover_bundles` fails the test while an empty match skips, and the negative control must include a malformed descriptor, or the guard silently reproduces the defect it fixes.
findings.text: §14 specifies the guard helper "decides absence from `discover_bundles()` alone: the guarded tests skip ... only when no reachable bundle carries jt-60sa", but `discover_bundles` calls `load_bundle_descriptor` (packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/machine_map.py:276) and raises `MachineMapError` on a malformed descriptor, so a malformed bundle is a third outcome the rule does not name; read literally, a raise leaves the helper unable to report "a reachable bundle carries jt-60sa", which is the exact "a duplicated or malformed bundle reads as absent" defect §14 exists to remove, and the §14 negative control exercises only the two-bundle case (which `discover_bundles` returns normally, without a raise) so it cannot see this half

findings.reason: the plan should say the refusal reads the name through the existing local-import of settings or drop the name from the message, so the variable keeps one owner.
findings.text: §12's edit to amend `bundle_for_machine`'s refusal to "also name `IMAS_ALAMBIC_MAP_PATH`" (packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/machine_map.py:294) spells the variable name a second time, while the name's sole owner is `ENV_MAP_PATH` (packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/settings.py:42); machine_map cannot top-level import settings (settings imports machine_map), but it already uses a function-local import of settings at machine_map.py:224, so the owner can be reused there rather than the literal copied — this is the same class of finding this plan's own history recorded and acted on (`_BUNDLE_ENV_VAR` moved to settings.py) and the two spellings will drift

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — the guard helper `tests/jt60sa_bundle.py` is specified to "decide absence from discover_bundles' result alone", but that result is not the only outcome: `discover_bundles` can itself raise.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §12 puts the `IMAS_ALAMBIC_MAP_PATH` name into `machine_map.py`'s refusal, a second owner of the name that `settings.py` already owns.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §12 changes the wording of an existing refusal and extends the store-role set, adds no public definition, CLI option, MCP view or refusal family, and names what it retires (the `figures_jt60sa_signals.py` interim `JT60SA_IDS_DIR` fallback).
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §12 extends the existing bundle-role lookup `_cache_root_from_bundle` (packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/settings.py:153) and values the new `ids_root` role from the already-landed `paths.JT60SA_IDS_DIR` (imas_ambix/data/paths.py:46, added by 23c512c2), and §14 cites the engine's `packages/imas-alambic/tests/test_eddb_local_transport.py` as the stand-in's existing home rather than inventing one.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §12 extends the one store-role helper rather than adding a parallel lookup, and §14 removes two duplicate test helpers rather than wrapping them.
